_what: MSCI Taiwan additions — the historical study behind the Aug-2026 scenarios

sample.returns: excess over TAIEX, close to close
sample.survivorship: survivor-safe — TWSE/TPEx day files retain delisted companies

asymmetry.note: permutation on the difference of MEDIANS; these distributions are too skewed for a mean-based test

out_of_sample.verdict: NO RULE SURVIVES. The best is gap1 at lift +0.30, but it selects only 7 of 18 test events and its binomial p is 0.108 — against a 0.008 threshold once the 6 rules tried are accounted for. The addition drift is not predictable out of sample from anything measured here.

schedules._note: saving is measured against the effective close, which is the tracker's benchmark — so the eff_close row is zero by construction and is the control that this is measured right

ADD.censored_note: events that never settle inside the horizon are NOT counted, so this is the median among those that did settle and understates the true wait
